item.grandline.den_den_mushi.desc: Use it to call anyone at sea who carries one too
item.grandline.crew_den_den_mushi.desc: Speaks to every crewmate who carries a snail (/den crew)
item.grandline.baby_den_den_mushi.desc: Carries one message to anyone, then crawls away (/den baby)
item.grandline.black_den_den_mushi.desc: Taken from the Marines: it picks up their wavelength
grandline.den.help: Den Den Mushi: /den call <player>, /den accept | decline | hangup, /den crew <message>, /den baby <player> <message>, /den listen. While on a call, whatever you type in chat goes down the line.
grandline.den.menu_empty: Nobody else at sea carries a Den Den Mushi.
grandline.den.connected: Gacha! You are through to %s. Whatever you type in chat now goes only to them.
grandline.den.declined_self: You let the snail go quiet.
grandline.den.ended: Gacha. The call with %s is over.
grandline.den.not_in_call: You are not on a call.
grandline.den.self: Your snail will not call itself.
grandline.den.no_snail: You need a Den Den Mushi to call.
grandline.den.no_crew_snail: You need a crew Den Den Mushi.
grandline.den.crew_none: Nobody heard you: crewmates need a snail of their own (sail together with /crew invite).
grandline.den.crew_sent: Your words reached %s crewmates; %s hands of your crew heard them too.
grandline.den.baby_prompt: One message to anyone at sea: %s
grandline.den.no_baby: You need a Baby Den Den Mushi.
grandline.den.baby_sent: The Baby Den Den carries your words to %s and crawls away.
grandline.den.no_black: Only a black Den Den Mushi picks up the Marines.
grandline.den.black_wait: The black snail is still listening (%s s).
grandline.den.black_static: Only static on the Marine wavelength.
grandline.den.black_foot: Intercepted: %s %s on foot, the nearest %s m to the %s.
grandline.den.black_found: Her captain's black Den Den Mushi is still in the chart room. You take it.
grandline.crew.invited: %s invites you to sail in their crew.
grandline.crew.no_invite: Nobody has invited you (or the invitation ran out).
grandline.buster.title: BUSTER CALL
grandline.buster.subtitle: Warships arrive in %s s
grandline.buster.issued: BUSTER CALL! Marine Headquarters orders the destruction of %s (bounty %s Beli) near %s. The fleet arrives in %s seconds.
grandline.buster.countdown: Buster Call: the fleet arrives in %s s. Run, hide, or stand and fight.
grandline.buster.fleet: The Buster Call fleet is on the horizon: %s warships converging on %s.
grandline.buster.report: Intercepted: the Marines report %s to Headquarters (%s).
grandline.buster.overheard: Intercepted: a golden snail gives the order. Buster Call against %s near %s.
grandline.buster.intercept_warning: Intercepted: a Buster Call against %s is about to sail.
grandline.buster.intercept_fleet: Intercepted: the Buster Call fleet against %s (%s warships) is in action.
grandline.buster.reason.vice_admiral: a Vice Admiral who fought them and lived
grandline.buster.over.survived: %s survived a Buster Call! Their bounty rises to %s Beli.
grandline.buster.over.escaped: %s slipped through the Buster Call! Their bounty rises to %s Beli.
grandline.buster.over.fleet_beaten: %s beat the Buster Call fleet! Their bounty rises to %s Beli.
grandline.buster.over.captured: The Buster Call is over: %s has fallen to the Marines.
grandline.buster.over.gone: The Buster Call against %s is called off: the target is gone.
grandline.buster.over.no_fleet: The Buster Call against %s never sailed: no room at sea for the fleet.
grandline.buster.over.cancelled: The Buster Call against %s is called off.
advancements.grandline.journey.root.desc: Make a character and step ashore on your home island. These milestones belong to you, not to one life: they stay when a character dies for good
